headline: Freedom Broker Downgrades PayPal Holdings on Valuation Concerns
summary: Freedom Broker has downgraded its stock rating on PayPal due to valuation concerns.
why: Analyst downgrades can influence retail and institutional sentiment, impacting short-term trading volumes and share price performance for major fintech firms.

impacts.name: PayPal Holdings Inc
impacts.why: Analyst downgrades typically increase selling pressure on the affected equity.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A brokerage downgrade alerts investors to potential overvaluation, leading to profit-taking or selling.
